policy_rules: OPD Consultations are covered for both Allopathy and AYUSH practitioners.
Dental treatments (including Root Canal, Extractions, etc.) are covered only if medically necessary.
Vision coverage includes one pair of prescribed corrective lenses and vision treatments.
Vaccinations must be WHO Approved to be eligible for coverage.
Annual Health Checkup (AHC) is provided for Employee and Spouse only and is over and above the OPD wallet.
Annual Health Checkup must be availed via Cashless mode.
Cosmetic surgery, treatments, consultations, and diagnostics are excluded unless required for physical function or treatment of an underlying ailment.
Pharmacy and Diagnostics prescribed by AYUSH registered practitioners are specifically excluded.
Orthodontic treatment, routine dental check-ups, and dental implants are excluded.
Investigations or treatments taken without existence of disease, illness, or symptoms are excluded.
Diagnostic tests and treatments require specialist advice or a valid prescription for claim eligibility.
Claims are capped at the maximum payable Outpatient medical expenses limit.
Obesity, IVF, Infertility, Cataract, and Lasik treatments are excluded.
